name: career-match-dev-benchmark-v0.2
disclaimer: Synthetic resume/job pairs constructed for controlled development evaluation. Not real candidate data. Not production hiring labels. Relevance grades are manually specified synthetic relevance judgments (development targets), not independently validated ground truth. No independent annotator agreement. Intended for model comparison and error analysis. Legacy CSV category labels are not used.
comparison_note: v0.1 (career-match-dev-eval-v0.1) is a 16-pair sanity-check fixture. v0.2 is the harder development benchmark for comparing TF-IDF, future sentence embeddings, and future hybrid rankers. Neither is a production benchmark.

relevance_scale.3: strong match — right role family, required work and seniority largely present
relevance_scale.2: moderate match — related role or partial skills; plausible interview with gaps
relevance_scale.1: weak match — overlapping tools or adjacent family, wrong core responsibilities or seniority
relevance_scale.0: mismatch — different occupation; includes keyword-stuffing and unrelated stacks

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We need a Machine Learning Engineer with 4+ years to train and ship Deep Learning models. The role uses Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and NLP in production, with Docker packaging and AWS deployment. Git and Linux are expected. Kubernetes is preferred. This is a modeling and model-serving role, not a dashboard-analyst seat and not a generic REST API backend role.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Data Scientist for product experimentation. You will analyze funnels with Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, and scikit-learn, write reproducible Git workflows, and explain results. We are not hiring a Deep Learning researcher and we are not hiring someone whose core work is REST APIs or frontend component development. Three or more years of applied analysis is expected.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Data Analyst for weekly business reporting. The work is SQL extracts, dashboard maintenance, and enough Python to clean spreadsheets. We do not need Deep Learning, model deployment, Kubernetes, or React. Typical fit is 2–3 years of reporting, not a research scientist track.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Backend Engineer with 4+ years shipping REST APIs in Python using FastAPI or Django, SQL, Docker, AWS, Linux, and Git. You will own service reliability and data access, not model training and not frontend component development.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Frontend Engineer for a TypeScript React and Next.js product. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git are required. Three or more years of UI work is expected. This is not a Python backend role and not a machine learning role.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Full-Stack Engineer to deliver React user interfaces and Python REST APIs in the same team. TypeScript, SQL, and Git are required. You should be comfortable across frontend component development and backend services. Three or more years. Not an MLOps or research ML seat.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: MLOps Engineer with 4+ years to own model deployment and serving ML models on cloud infrastructure. The stack is Python automation, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Git, and Linux. You will productionize other people's training jobs. This is not a research scientist role and not a frontend role.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer to build batch pipelines into relational warehouses. Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Spark, Airflow, Docker, and AWS are in daily use. Git required. Three or more years. We need reliable pipelines, not dashboard storytelling and not neural-network research.
